peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 17.3% below its local comparables; 2 of 44 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (71.6): 5.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 36 of 51 similar developments (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 83.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,704,000 ($1,790 psf, 904–1,011 sq ft; 8 resales, Jun 2024–May 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,144 psf (range $2,086–2,232); 16.5% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $337,000 less. 3-bedroom: median $2,571,444 ($1,882 psf, 1,345–1,410 sq ft; 14 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,302 psf (range $2,074–2,437); 18.2% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $574,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Bright Hill MRT about 300 m, Mayflower MRT about 940 m; closer than 20 of 51 similar developments (the same as 3). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 3 within 2 km; nearest Ai Tong School about 600 m; more than 9 of 51 similar developments (the same as 14). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 780 m), more than 6 of 51 similar developments (the same as 6); nearest hawker centre Jalan Leban Food Centre about 810 m; nearest park Bishan-Ang Mo Kio Park (Pond Gardens) about 200 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 2 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Artisan 8, 4 new sales, about 1,430 m; Lentoria, 27 new sales, about 1,930 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 32 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 31 new sales and 248 resales (279 purchases); new sales were 11.1% of these purchases. Subsales (34) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: upcoming Thomson Reserve development, about 920 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 248 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 5 of 51 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 248 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 309 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−19.7%). Planning-area private resales −23.4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
